[[File:Pokémon Rising Again Korean Soundtrack cover.png|200px|thumb|right|Single cover]]
'''Tomorrow's Steps''' (Korean: '''내일의 발걸음''' ''Naeir-ui Balgeoreum'') is the ending theme for the Korean dub of the ''[[Rising Again]]'' arc and the sixth of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]''. It debuted in [[HZ115]], replacing [[Go Beyond]]. It uses the same animation as its corresponding Japanese ending theme, [[Asleep or Awake]].

The full version of the song was released on April 21, 2026. The ending animation video was uploaded to the Korean Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on April 28, 2026.
